profile.location: Sacramento, California (services associated with Calvary Cemetery)
profile.short_description: Sacramento Catholic funeral and cemetery services guiding families through immediate funeral needs after a death and helping them plan funeral and cemetery arrangements ahead of time.
profile.detailed_profile: This organization offers Catholic funeral and cemetery services in Sacramento. For families facing an immediate loss, it provides guidance through the funeral and cemetery planning process, with a dedicated phone line (916-452-4831) for those who have lost a loved one. Its services are grounded in Catholic beliefs in the immortality of the soul and the resurrection of the body, offering options for funeral rites and burial. It also promotes planning ahead for funeral and cemetery services, framing pre-planning as a way to ensure one's wishes are met, avoid emotional overspending, and give peace of mind to family members. The organization is connected to Calvary Cemetery, where a Vietnam Veterans' Memorial Wall Project — the first replica of the Washington, D.C. memorial west of Missouri — is being developed, with options to learn more or donate to the project.
profile.self_introduction: We are a Catholic funeral and cemetery services organization in Sacramento. We guide families through funeral arrangements and burial when a loved one passes, and we help individuals plan ahead for their own funeral and cemetery services. Our work at Calvary Cemetery also includes the Vietnam Veterans' Memorial Wall replica project, honoring those who served.

profile.name: Chicha San Chen NorCal
profile.cuisine_or_specialty: Taiwanese premium tea, high mountain Lishan Oolong, teapresso-brewed tea drinks
profile.location: 20688 Stevens Creek Blvd, Cupertino, CA; additional location in Daly City, CA; Berkeley location coming soon
profile.short_description: Taiwanese tea house in Cupertino individually brewing fresh cups of high mountain Lishan Oolong tea, with tea tastings, ceremonies, evening tea drinks, and catering.
profile.detailed_profile: Chicha San Chen NorCal is a Taiwanese tea house with over 20 years of tea brewing heritage, located at 20688 Stevens Creek Blvd in Cupertino, with a second serving point in Daly City and a Berkeley location coming soon. Every cup is brewed individually using their proprietary LION teapresso machine, which uses high temperature and pressure to extract the tea's fragrance and essence within seconds. Their signature teas are Lishan Oolongs harvested at 6,000-6,600 ft on Taiwan's Lishan Mountain, offered in five customized roasting profiles with distinct fragrances and tastes. Guests can join complimentary tea tasting sessions, book reservation-only tea ceremonies with Taiwanese Tea Masters, and enjoy cocktail-inspired tea drinks served during evening hours. The shop also sells hand-crafted ceramic tea canisters made by tea masters from Taiwan, which can be filled with favorite tea leaves in a reservation-required sealing ceremony, and provides customizable tea catering for company events and private parties.
profile.self_introduction: We are Chicha San Chen NorCal, a Taiwanese tea house in Cupertino dedicated to fresh tea brewing for more than 20 years. Each cup is brewed individually with our patented LION teapresso machine, featuring high mountain Lishan Oolong teas in five distinct roasting profiles. Join us for a complimentary tea tasting session, reserve a tea ceremony with our Tea Masters from Taiwan, or try our cocktail-inspired tea drinks during evening serving hours. We also offer customizable tea catering for company events and private parties throughout Northern California.

profile.short_description: UC Santa Barbara's Distribution & Logistical Services provides mail services, central receiving, furniture moving, surplus sales, and materiel & logistics for campus departments and residential operations.
profile.detailed_profile: Distribution & Logistical Services (DLS) operates out of Building 507 on Henry T. Yang Drive at UC Santa Barbara. The department provides essential services including UCSB Mail Services, Central Receiving, Furniture Services, Surplus Sales, and Materiel & Logistics for all units in the Residential Operations department. profile.name: Gnomies Preschool
profile.cuisine_or_specialty: play-based, nature-focused early childhood education with an emergent, child-centered curriculum
profile.location: 7985 Valentine Ave & 487 Watertrough Rd, Sebastopol, CA
profile.short_description: A holistic, play-based preschool in Sebastopol, CA emphasizing nature, creativity, and outdoor education, with a morning program and aftercare.
profile.detailed_profile: Gnomies Preschool operates two campuses in Sebastopol, California (7985 Valentine Avenue and 487 Watertrough Road) and offers a holistic, child-centered learning environment built around nature, creativity, and play. Its emergent curriculum follows children's interests through project-based learning, with teachers acting as facilitators who support conflict resolution, empathy, and communication. A heavy emphasis is placed on outdoor education: weekly walks to Ragle Ranch Park include exploring redwoods, climbing oaks, hiking the Blackberry Trail, observing wildlife, and building forts (known to families as Forest Friday). The school has four classrooms—a front room with library and kitchen for cooking projects, a middle room with blocks, Magnatiles, train table, and dramatic play, an art room with sensory table, watercolors, and easels—plus a large yard with trikes, a sandbox, and a wooden ship for climbing. Daily schedule elements include organic snack, music and movement, yoga and meditation, and closing circle time. Programs include a morning session from 9am-1pm and aftercare from 1-5pm, with a 1:7 teacher-to-child ratio. A testimonial also mentions summer camps. An open house is scheduled for Sunday, March 29, 2026 at 12pm at the Watertrough campus.
profile.self_introduction: We are Gnomies Preschool, a play-based, nature-focused preschool with campuses in Sebastopol, California. Our child-centered, emergent curriculum combines hands-on projects, art, music, and yoga with daily outdoor play and weekly forest days at Ragle Ranch Park. We offer a morning program from 9 to 1 and aftercare until 5, maintaining a small teacher-to-child ratio of 1:7. Families are welcome to join one of our open houses to see our classrooms and yard in person.

profile.cuisine_or_specialty: American breakfast and brunch with specialty cocktails, farm-to-table ingredients, and daily baked goods
profile.location: Santa Cruz, California (near Twin Lakes State Beach)
profile.short_description: A farm-to-table breakfast and brunch cafe in Santa Cruz serving made-from-scratch food, fresh local produce, and award-winning specialty cocktails like the Bloody Mary.
profile.detailed_profile: Harbor Cafe is a popular breakfast, lunch, and drinks spot in Santa Cruz known for wholesome, made-from-scratch food. Biscuits and croissants are baked daily, and salsas, sauces, and dressings are made in-house using fresh local produce delivered by Watsonville Coast Produce. profile.detailed_profile: Submarina has been making subs, sandwiches and salads since 1977, using fresh locally sourced produce, premium meats, aged California cheeses, and bread baked fresh every day. Each location is individually owned and operated by licensed franchisees, with stores across San Diego, Riverside, and Orange County/Los Angeles as well as U.S. territories. The brand offers DoorDash ordering in addition to phone and in-person orders. Its catering program features custom-made party subs (each foot serves about 4-5 people, two-foot minimum), sub sandwich platters, wrap platters, bagged lunches in two sizes, and assorted salad bowls with potato, macaroni, or green salad. Catering consultants can customize orders around event needs and budget, and the company can accommodate last-minute event needs though large orders require advance notice. The company story traces back to brothers Brian and Matt Kennedy, the 'Sub-bros,' who opened their first San Diego franchise in 1996 and bought the company in 2017.
profile.self_introduction: We are Submarina, a California sandwich shop making great tasting subs, sandwiches, and salads since 1977. Our bread is baked fresh every day, and we use fresh locally sourced produce, premium hand-sliced meats, and aged California cheeses. Beyond our restaurant locations, we offer custom catering for events of all sizes, from party subs to bagged lunches and platters for business meetings.

profile.name: The Park Gym
profile.cuisine_or_specialty: boxing, fitness, and personal training
profile.location: 1823 Divisadero Street, San Francisco, CA 94115
profile.short_description: San Francisco boxing gym offering comprehensive boxing classes, personal training, and a welcoming community for all skill levels.
profile.detailed_profile: The Park Gym is a boxing and fitness gym located at 1823 Divisadero Street in San Francisco. The gym runs a structured boxing curriculum described as one of the most comprehensive and well-designed programs, aimed at challenging members physically while increasing mental focus and building confidence. The program uses a level system: members who pass the level two test gain access to level two classes covering more challenging combinations, defensive tactics, rhythm, and movement. Beyond boxing classes, the gym offers personal training in one-on-one and small group formats, with experienced trainers creating tailored programs based on individual goals across boxing, strength training, and overall wellness. Training sessions are designed to help members move better, grow stronger, and age well, supporting all boxing and fitness levels. The gym positions itself as a community space where people can train, lift, box, or simply hang out.
profile.self_introduction: We are The Park Gym, San Francisco's boxing gym on Divisadero Street. Our comprehensive boxing curriculum welcomes everyone from complete beginners to experienced fighters, and our level system lets you progress into advanced classes as your technique improves. We also offer one-on-one and small group personal training tailored to your goals, whether that's boxing, strength training, or overall wellness. More than a gym, we're a community where you can train, lift, box, or just hang out.

profile.name: The Pear Theatre
profile.cuisine_or_specialty: classic plays, contemporary drama, world premiere productions, and short plays by local playwrights
profile.location: San Francisco Bay Area, California
profile.short_description: An intimate Bay Area theatre founded in 2002 producing intellectually stimulating, emotionally powerful professional productions of classics and new works, currently celebrating its 25th season.
profile.detailed_profile: The Pear Theatre was founded in 2002 with a mission to offer theatre that challenges the community to see the world fully through intellectually stimulating, emotionally powerful, professional productions. Its seasons include classics, contemporary plays, short plays by local playwrights, and world premiere productions of new works. The theatre is currently running its 25th season, subtitled 'Defiant Voices. Vibrant Art. 25 Years Bold.', focused on stories of people on the margins. Its current production, a San Francisco Bay Area premiere about Anne Brontë directed by Wynne Chan with assistant direction by Karen Law, plays November 6-22, and tickets are on sale. Season 25 subscriptions are available. The theatre emphasizes diverse voices in its programming and an inclusive environment among artists, staff, volunteers, and audiences, and has published new Core Values from its Board of Directors and Staff.
profile.self_introduction: We are The Pear Theatre, a bold, independent professional theatre in the San Francisco Bay Area. Since 2002 we have produced classics, contemporary plays, short plays by local playwrights, and world premieres that challenge as much as they entertain. Our 25th season celebrates defiant voices and vibrant art, and season subscriptions and single tickets are now on sale. If you value language, risk, and community, there is a seat for you here.

profile.detailed_profile: Tremigo Mexican Kitchen & Tequila Bar, an award-winning 'Best of Tahoe' restaurant, is located in The Village at Palisades Tahoe (Squaw Valley) in Olympic Valley, CA. Chef Antonio Abundiz, originally from Guadalajara, leads the kitchen with family-friendly dishes including sizzling fajitas, homemade chile rellenos, and taco boards made with non-GMO corn and local ingredients. Guests can pair their meals with a wide selection of tequila and margaritas in a lively, stylish atmosphere suitable for lunch or dinner. The restaurant also offers a Private Dining Room called the Tequila Room, available for rehearsal dinners, corporate events, and group meetings.

profile.name: USA Properties Fund
profile.type: Apartment community developer and property manager (affordable, senior, and market-rate housing)
profile.cuisine_or_specialty: Affordable housing, senior apartment communities, and market-rate apartment development
profile.location: Communities across California, Nevada, and Oregon (since 1981)
profile.short_description: USA Properties Fund develops, builds, and manages affordable, senior, and market-rate apartment communities across California, Nevada, and Oregon, with 95+ current communities and 21,000+ homes developed.
profile.detailed_profile: Founded in 1981, USA Properties Fund is a housing developer and multifamily property manager with more than 45 years of experience and over 21,000 homes developed across California, Nevada, and Oregon. Its portfolio spans affordable housing, affordable senior communities, and market-rate apartments, supported by resident-focused services and programs. The company works through public-private partnerships with cities, financial institutions such as Bank of America and Citi Community Capital, and housing organizations like Bay Area Housing Innovation Fund and Housing Trust Silicon Valley. Recent projects include The Crawford, a 265-unit affordable apartment community in west Roseville, and Centerville Plaza, a 290-unit affordable community in Fremont near the Fremont-Centerville Station with Amtrak and ACE train service. The company also rebuilds homes in disaster-affected areas, such as fire-ravaged Grizzly Flats, and runs the JB Brown Fund (with LifeSTEPS), which has helped about 1,500 low-income residents with college attendance, youth sports, and financial challenges since 2011. In-house teams cover development, construction, operations, resident services, and corporate functions, with active hiring across multifamily management and resident services.
profile.self_introduction: We are USA Properties Fund, a developer, builder, and manager of affordable, senior, and market-rate apartment communities across California, Nevada, and Oregon since 1981. With more than 95 communities and over 21,000 homes developed, we help renters find apartments suited to everyday life, from low-income and senior housing to market-rate communities with amenities. Beyond housing, we support residents through services and programs, and we partner with cities, banks, and community organizations to build lasting communities.

profile.short_description: World-class junior tennis academy in Ojai, CA offering year-round full-time training, a boarding school, a top college placement program, and summer and holiday camps.
profile.detailed_profile: Founded by Mark Weil in 1997, Weil Tennis Academy is a junior tennis training academy and boarding school in Ojai, California. It describes itself as a global community of students, teachers, coaches, and residential parents united by tennis and academics, where students train and compete as a team in a close, supportive residential environment described as a 'home away from home.' The academy offers full-time year-round training, summer and holiday camps, and hosts Southern California ITF, ITA, and USTA tournaments. Its College Placement Program is a major focus: recent graduating classes have committed to universities including Harvard, UCLA, the University of Pennsylvania, Arizona State, and Tulane, with the Class of 2026 reported to receive over $2,000,000 in college scholarships.
profile.self_introduction: We are a junior tennis academy and boarding school in Ojai, California, founded by Mark Weil in 1997. Our students train full-time year-round as a team while studying in our academic program, and our College Placement Program has helped graduates earn spots and scholarships at universities like Harvard, UCLA, and Penn. We also run summer and holiday tennis camps and host ITF, ITA, and USTA tournaments in Southern California.

The school's identity as an arts-focused elementary school comes from its name; no specific programs, staff, hours, or enrollment details for Wren Ave itself appear on the page.
profile.self_introduction: We are Wren Ave Elementary School of the Arts, a public elementary school in the Mt. Diablo Unified School District.
